'''21''' was a location on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] recruiter [[Tay Vanis]] left a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] outside this location for potential recruits [[Raleigh Dawn]] and later [[Sammie Staable]].
